adds.rationale: AST SpaceMobile signed definitive commercial agreements with both AT&T and Verizon in May 2024 for nationwide space-based cellular broadband, a concrete commercial milestone in the satellite-services buildup the profile names as the top next-wave priority, and a stronger near-term catalyst than the space-bucket incumbent it replaces.

news_evidence.summary: AST SpaceMobile strikes definitive commercial agreement with AT&T through 2030, targeting near-100% continental US coverage on premium low-band spectrum
Verizon makes $100M strategic commitment to AST SpaceMobile ($65M prepayment + $35M convertible notes) as part of a space-based broadband partnership

removes.rationale: Planet Labs' growth has decelerated into the mid-teens with continued heavy cash burn and the stock printed a fresh all-time low this quarter, a fundamental softening of the thesis relative to the stronger satellite-services buildup signal now available in the same wave bucket.

news_evidence.summary: Planet Labs stock hit an all-time low of $1.67 on April 30, 2024
Fiscal Q1 2025 results (period ended April 30, 2024, reported June 6): revenue up only 15% YoY to $60.4M, net loss of $29.3M, continued cash burn despite 95% recurring ACV

rationale_overall: The watchlist was already well diversified across every named wave and sits at the 16-ticker cap, so this quarter's action is a single swap. Rocket Lab posted record Q1 revenue (+69% YoY) and continued Neutron progress, Centrus/Cameco got a real regulatory tailwind from the May 13 signing of the Prohibiting Russian Uranium Imports Act, quantum names broadly rallied reinforcing IonQ, and Nvidia/Microsoft AI fundamentals remained strong (Nvidia Q1 FY25 data-center revenue +427% YoY) — none of these current holdings show thesis breach, so they are kept. The one swap trades a weakening, cash-burning Planet Labs position for AST SpaceMobile, which just landed definitive nationwide commercial agreements with AT&T and Verizon, a cleaner buildup-phase satellite-services bet inside the same wave bucket. A prospective second quantum add was considered but not actioned for lack of a clean offsetting removal.
